name: get_host_shell
description: Inspect the default shell and startup directory, and discover commands across activities, including ones whose run_host_shell call is still waiting. Command IDs belong to this runtime. Finished handles have bounded retention; full logs remain independently available.

name: run_host_shell
description: Each call starts a fresh shell; keep a process running to preserve shell or REPL state across calls. Commands that finish execution and cleanup during the wait return a final result; otherwise the call returns command_id and callback_id, with one completion observation arranged for this session. Its registration lets the session sleep while awaiting the outcome without polling. A callback_id confirms that observation even if the snapshot is already terminal. Initial previews are independent of continuation reads, which may repeat them. Full output remains in log files.

cwd.description: Literal path; relative paths and omission use the kernel's startup directory.

login.description: Load startup files through -lc; default false.

mode.description: batch (default) has closed stdin; pipe accepts streamed input; terminal provides terminal behavior with merged stdout/stderr. Batch and pipe preserve output bytes; terminal processing can alter them.

timeout_ms.description: Stops the command at expiry. Omit to run without a deadline.

max_output_bytes.description: Shared by stdout and stderr after JSON encoding; default 16384. Metadata and native media are additional.

interpretation.description: Present final stdout text, up to 16 KiB, as an image URL passed unchanged to the model service. Image bytes are recognized automatically.

yield_ms.description: Omit for 1000. Use 0 to observe immediately, a short wait to handle other work sooner, or a longer wait when obtaining the result is more useful than proceeding now.

name: continue_host_shell
description: Read output or act on an existing command. Continue calls share per-stream cursors across activities, independently of the run call's initial preview and completion callback. This call preserves the original completion destination and registers no new callback. The first final continue observation can supply native stdout once across activities, independently of initial previews, text cursors, and callback delivery. Callback text carries media descriptions. A finished background handle retires when its output is drained.

command_id.description: Runtime command handle returned by run_host_shell or listed by get_host_shell.

text.description: Limited to 16384 UTF-8 bytes. Only one write can be pending; stdin.pending and stdin.error report delivery.

eof.description: After this text, close pipe stdin or send terminal Ctrl-D. Terminal input remains writable.

name.description: Send SIGINT, SIGTERM, or SIGKILL, respectively. Interrupt targets the terminal foreground group; terminate and kill cover its original session. Without a terminal, signals target the command's process group.

action.description: Apply input or control before reading output; omit to read only. Controls remain available while another call waits. Resize requires terminal mode.

yield_ms.description: Waits for unread output or completion. Omit for 1000; use 0 to inspect the current state, or a longer wait when the next decision needs new output.

max_output_bytes.description: Shared by stdout and stderr after JSON encoding; default 16384. Metadata and native media are additional.
